question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- Final answer: count of actors who made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director
WITH yash_collabs AS (
    SELECT c.PID, COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) as yash_count
    FROM M_Director d
    JOIN Movie m ON d.MID = m.MID
    JOIN M_Cast c ON m.MID = c.MID
    WHERE d.PID = 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY c.PID
),
other_collabs AS (
    SELECT c.PID, d.PID as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) as director_count
    FROM M_Director d
    JOIN Movie m ON d.MID = m.MID
    JOIN M_Cast c ON m.MID = c.MID
    WHERE d.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY c.PID, d.PID
),
max_other AS (
    SELECT PID, MAX(director_count) as max_other_count
    FROM other_collabs
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM yash_collabs yc
LEFT JOIN max_other mo ON yc.PID = mo.PID
WHERE yc.yash_count > COALESCE(mo.max_other_count, 0)
